Title: General availability: Mobile Apps SDKs for Apache Cordova and JavaScript

Body.Content: We released the Mobile Apps SDK for Apache Cordova v2.0.0, and the Mobile Apps SDK for JavaScript. This completes the suite of mobile platforms that the Mobile Apps feature of Azure App Service supports. Read more in our blog post.
